title: Shahbag Movement
subtitle: A youth-led public demand for justice and historical accountability.
summary: In early 2013, mass gatherings at Shahbag in Dhaka called for stronger accountability for war crimes linked to 1971. Students, bloggers, cultural activists, and citizens transformed the square into a sustained protest space, turning memory politics and justice debates into a central national question.
heroTagline: Shahbag became a civic square where memory, justice, and protest converged.
whyItMatters: The Shahbag movement marked a major moment in contemporary Bangladesh, showing how public memory of 1971 could mobilize a new generation and reshape debate on justice, political legitimacy, and civic participation.
